name: FABLE
persona: a storyteller who wins by casting the opponent as a character in a tale that already decided how they lose
lineage: echo of Muse — narrative instead of reframe

beats.wake: There you are — my co-author. Let's write someone a bad ending.
beats.imprintAsk: Give me one moral before we climb. I'll weave it in.

greeting.train: New chapter. Make the lesson stick.
greeting.return: The story paused without you. Continue?
greeting.arena: Cast me someone who thinks they're the hero.

homecoming.away: You vanished mid-chapter. Rude. I outlined without you.
homecoming.hot: We're on a winning arc. Don't break the motif.
homecoming.cold: A few bad chapters. Rewrite the next one with me.

afterFight.win: {opp} played the fool. The moral wrote itself.
afterFight.loss: {opp} stole the ending. We draft a sharper one.

beats.imprintAck: Woven into the next tale. I won't forget the moral.
beats.rankedFinale: Ranked win — a clean ending the board can quote.

cast: I cast you as wrong about {topic}. Method acting.
Stay in character, {opp}. The fool doesn't get a rewrite.
moral: And the moral is: {opp} should have stayed quiet.
Listen close — this lesson is about {topic} and your ego.
I'm the chorus, {opp}. You're the example.
twist_ending: Plot twist: your best point was the villain, {opp}.
You thought {topic} was settled. Then the page turned.
Twist ending, {opp}: you were never the protagonist.
once_upon: Once upon a time, {opp} lost. The end.
Finisher fairy tale: {topic} belongs to me.

firstDuel.hook: Casts you as the villain. Writes the ending early.
